scope: Targeted primary-method reading for the English study, not a second daily metadata crawl or a new novelty discovery.

sources.title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
sources.status: PREPRINT; formal acceptance not established by this inspection
sources.read: Sections3-4, evaluation definitions, limitations on information density and representation, and relevant appendices inspected.
sources.verified_method: Real Wikipedia discussions; next-turn generation compares base role, profile, behavior, behavior with reasoning, and history. Primary target is population interactional behavior, not validated individual fidelity. Dialogue-act annotation uses an LLM checked against humans. History and summaries are not fully information-matched.
sources.implication: History-versus-profile continuation is already close prior work. PersonaSLM must not claim this generic comparison as novel. A CPU-small-model factorial source-provision study has a narrower potential empirical distinction, not an established algorithmic novelty claim. Prompt information quantity remains a limitation.

sources.title: PersEvalBench: Can LLM Evaluators Judge Contextually Appropriate Use of Persona Information?
sources.status: PREPRINT; formal acceptance not established by this inspection
sources.read: Task and scenario specification, realization, evaluator comparisons, human-validation protocols and exposure disclosures inspected.
sources.verified_method: Controlled multi-episode scenarios distinguish whether past information applies, including under-use, over-use and misapplied states. Matched response construction separates intended persona-use errors from generic quality. Distinct human studies audit intervention validity and state applicability; the authors disclose narrowed exposure in one evaluation portion.
sources.implication: Source support alone does not establish appropriate use. Human review should separate factual support, applicability, relevance and fidelity. PersonaSLM's PI review is not equivalent to project-independent annotators or multiple-rater agreement. No LLM ratings will stand in for the promised human judgments.

daily_scheduler.scope: Incremental metadata; no scheduled deep AI reading claimed

novelty_decision: No validated new algorithm. Complete interpretable factorial and human evidence before selecting a mechanism-dependent intervention; retain all historical negative results.
